name: Malefactor
overview: The topic of the malefactor is vividly illustrated in the account of Jesus' crucifixion, where two thieves were crucified alongside Him. These men, identified as malefactors, were part of the scene where bystanders and religious leaders mocked Jesus, challenging His identity as the Son of God and King of Israel by urging Him to save Himself if He truly had divine power. This moment highlights the rejection and scorn Jesus faced even in His final hours, underscoring the contrast between His saving mission and the condemnation of those crucified with Him.
